acceptance_criteria.criterion: Test test_getID verifies the ID getter returns the normalised icon ID.
Test test_getPrefix verifies the prefix getter returns the FA prefix string.
Test test_getIconName verifies the icon name getter returns the FA icon name.
Test test_getFullIconName verifies prefix:name format when prefix is present, and name-only when prefix is empty.
Test test_createIcon verifies the factory returns a UI_Icon instance with correct configuration.
Test test_camelCaseConversion verifies getMethodName() converts underscore-separated IDs to camelCase.
Test test_normaliseID verifies IconInfo::normaliseID() replaces hyphens and spaces with underscores.

summary: Created tests/AppFrameworkTests/UI/IconInfoTest.php with all 7 required test methods covering all 8 ACs. All 7 tests pass (17 assertions). Full UI test suite regression pass: 49 tests, 303 assertions, no regressions.

comments.note: test_getFullIconName covers both the with-prefix (far:sun) and no-prefix (planet) branches of getFullIconName() in a single test method with clear per-assertion messages.

test_createIcon tests both the setType($iconName, $prefix) code path (prefix present) and the setType($iconName) code path (empty prefix), and asserts both the icon type and prefix via UI_Icon::getType()/getPrefix().
test_camelCaseConversion covers three cases: single-segment ID (no change), two-segment (attentionRequired), and three-segment (myIconName).
test_normaliseID covers hyphens, spaces, already-normalised IDs, and a mixed hyphen+space string — four distinct edge cases.
Regression pass: full AppFrameworkTests\UI namespace (49 tests, 303 assertions) passes cleanly after adding the new test file.

summary: Code review PASS with two Fix-Forward edits applied. The test file is well-structured, follows project conventions (final class, strict_types, section dividers, descriptive assertion messages), and provides thorough edge-case coverage across all 7 required test methods. No blocking issues found. Two minor non-behavioral fixes applied directly: (1) removed two unused private helper methods (createWithPrefix/createWithoutPrefix) that were defined but never called — dead code that could mislead future contributors; (2) corrected a misleading inline comment in test_createIcon that incorrectly stated the prefix 'defaults to fa' when the no-prefix path simply omits the prefix argument entirely. All 7 tests still pass (17 assertions) after the fixes.

comments.note: Removed two unused private helper methods createWithPrefix() and createWithoutPrefix() from IconInfoTest.php. Both were defined but never called — all test methods inline their own IconInfo construction. Dead helper methods add noise and could mislead future contributors into thinking there is a shared fixture convention in use.

Corrected inline comment in test_createIcon() from 'prefix defaults to fa' to 'no prefix argument is passed'. The source createIcon() method calls setType($iconName) with no second argument when prefix is empty — it does not explicitly default to 'fa'. The original comment was factually inaccurate about what the production code does.

No blocking issues. Test naming, structure, and coverage align well with the existing IconCollectionTest.php pattern in the same namespace. Edge cases for normaliseID() (mixed hyphens+spaces), getFullIconName() (empty-prefix branch), and getMethodName() (1-, 2-, and 3-segment IDs) are all covered.

notes: IconInfoTest.php created and fully passing. All 9 ACs met. 7 tests, 17 assertions. Full UI regression suite (49 tests, 303 assertions) also passes cleanly. Reviewer should check test quality, naming conventions, and whether edge-case coverage is sufficient before PASS.
